name: io.github.sepehr071/irantalent-mcp
title: IranTalent Jobs
description: Read-only IranTalent (irantalent.com) job portal: search jobs, ad details, companies, reviews.

environmentVariables.name: IRANTALENT_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the IranTalent requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
